name: Palo Alto Networks 9
description: The Sumo Logic App for Palo Alto Networks 9 utilizes PANOS 9 new features in predefined dashboards to provide extensive security analytics throughout your Palo Alto Networks environment.

children.name: Palo Alto Networks 9 - Configuration Analysis
children.description: The Palo Alto Networks 9 - Configuration Analysis dashboard provides visibility into device configuration activity on your network.

panels.name: Configuration Status
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",CONFIG,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as vsys, 10 as cmd, 11 as admin, 12 as client, 13 as result, 14 as path, 15 as before_change_detail, 16 as after_change_detail, 17 as seqNum, 18 as action_flags, 19 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l1, 20 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l2, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l3, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l4, 23 as vsys_name, 24 as DeviceName
| where type = "CONFIG"
| count as eventCount by result
| sort by eventCount, result asc

panels.name: Configuration Status Trend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",CONFIG,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as vsys, 10 as cmd, 11 as admin, 12 as client, 13 as result, 14 as path, 15 as before_change_detail, 16 as after_change_detail, 17 as seqNum, 18 as action_flags, 19 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l1, 20 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l2, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l3, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l4, 23 as vsys_name, 24 as DeviceName
| where type = "CONFIG"
| timeslice 1d
| count as eventCount by _timeslice, result
| transpose row _timeslice column result

children.name: Palo Alto Networks 9 - HIPMatch Monitoring
children.description: The Palo Alto Networks 9 - HIPMatch Monitoring dashboard provides visibility into the number of HIP events, HIP name, HIP type, and firewall devices accessing your network. Panels also show information on active hosts and users, as well as users and systems with multiple policy violations.

panels.name: Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",HIPMATCH,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_user, 9 as virtual_system, 10 as machine_name, 11 as OS, 12 as src_addr, 13 as hip, 14 as RepeatCount, 15 as HIP_Type, 16 as f3, 17 as f4, 18 as seqNum, 19 as action_flags, 20 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 24 as vsys_name, 25 as DeviceName, 26 as vsys_id, 27 as ipv6_src_addr, 28 as HostID
| where type = "HIPMATCH"
| count

| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_user, 9 as virtual_system, 10 as machine_name, 11 as OS, 12 as src_addr, 13 as hip, 14 as RepeatCount, 15 as HIP_Type, 16 as f3, 17 as f4, 18 as seqNum, 19 as action_flags, 20 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 24 as vsys_name, 25 as DeviceName, 26 as vsys_id, 27 as ipv6_src_addr, 28 as HostID

children.name: Palo Alto Networks 9 - High Severity Threats
children.description: The Palo Alto Networks 9 - High Severity Threats dashboard provides visibility into high severity threats that are coming from and impacting the most hosts.

panels.name: High Severity Threats Impacting Most Destination IPs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",THREAT," !(",file," or ",url,") (high or critical)
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as src_ip, 9 as dest_ip, 10 as NAT_src_ip, 11 as NAT_dest_ip, 12 as ruleName, 13 as src_user, 14 as dest_user, 15 as app, 16 as vsys, 17 as src_zone, 18 as dest_zone, 19 as inbound_interface, 20 as outbound_interface, 21 as LogAction, 22 as f3, 23 as SessonID, 24 as RepeatCount, 25 as src_port, 26 as dest_port, 27 as NAT_src_port, 28 as NAT_dest_port, 29 as flags, 30 as protocol, 31 as action, 32 as urlORFileName, 33 as Threat_Content_Name, 34 as category, 35 as severity, 36 as direction, 37 as seqNum, 38 as action_flags, 39 as src_country, 40 as dest_country, 41 as f4, 42 as content_type, 43 as pcap_id, 44 as filedigest, 45 as cloud, 46 as url_idx, 47 as user_agent, 48 as filetype, 49 as xff, 50 as referer, 51 as sender, 52 as subject, 53 as recipient, 54 as reportid, 55 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l1, 56 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l2, 57 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l3, 58 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_l4, 59 as vsys_name, 60 as DeviceName, 61 as f5, 62 as Source_VM_UUID, 63 as Destination_VM_UUID, 64 as method, 65 as Tunnel_ID_IMSI, 66 as Monitor_Tag_IMEI, 67 as Parent_Session_ID, 68 as parent_start_time, 69 as Tunnel, 70 as thr_category, 71 as contentver, 72 as f6, 73 as SCTP_Association_ID, 74 as Payload_Protocol_ID, 75 as http_headers, 76 as URLCategoryList, 77 as UUIDforrule, 78 as HTTP2Connection
| where type = "THREAT" and subtype not in ("file", "url") and severity in ("high", "critical")
| count_distinct(dest_ip) as UniqueDestIPs by subtype, Threat_Content_Name
| sort by UniqueDestIPs, subtype, Threat_Content_Name
| limit 10

children.name: Palo Alto Networks 9 - Threat Overview
children.description: The Palo Alto Networks 9 - Threat Overview dashboard provides insights into the types of threats on your network, threat severity, and threat comparisons over time. Panels also display information on threats impacting the most IPs, IPs receiving multiple threats, IPs generating threats, and users who are impacted by threats.

children.name: Palo Alto Networks 9 - USERID Monitoring
children.description: The Palo Alto Networks 9 - USERID Monitoring dashboard provides insights into user activity on your network, with information on authentication factor, content type, and trends for content and new user activity. Panels also show details on the top firewall devices, source IPs, active users, and users who connected from multiple IPs.

panels.name: Authentication Factor
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",USERID,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as virtual_system, 9 as src_ip, 10 as src_user, 11 as Data_Source_Name, 12 as Event_ID, 13 as RepeatCount, 14 as TimeOutThreshold, 15 as src_port, 16 as dest_port, 17 as DataSource, 18 as DataSourceType, 19 as seqNum, 20 as action_flags, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 24 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 25 as vsys_name, 26 as DeviceName, 27 as vsys_id, 28 as factortype, 29 as factorcompletiontime, 30 as factorno, 31 as f3, 32 as f4, 33 as ugflags, 34 as userbysource
| where type = "USERID"
| if (factorno = "1", "Primary Authentication", "Multifactor Authentication") as AuthenticationFactor
| count by AuthenticationFactor

panels.name: Content Type
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",USERID,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as virtual_system, 9 as src_ip, 10 as src_user, 11 as Data_Source_Name, 12 as Event_ID, 13 as RepeatCount, 14 as TimeOutThreshold, 15 as src_port, 16 as dest_port, 17 as DataSource, 18 as DataSourceType, 19 as seqNum, 20 as action_flags, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 24 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 25 as vsys_name, 26 as DeviceName, 27 as vsys_id, 28 as factortype, 29 as factorcompletiontime, 30 as factorno, 31 as f3, 32 as f4, 33 as ugflags, 34 as userbysource
| where type = "USERID"
| count by subtype, DataSource, DataSourceType | sort by _count, subtype

panels.name: Content Type Trend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",USERID,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as virtual_system, 9 as src_ip, 10 as src_user, 11 as Data_Source_Name, 12 as Event_ID, 13 as RepeatCount, 14 as TimeOutThreshold, 15 as src_port, 16 as dest_port, 17 as DataSource, 18 as DataSourceType, 19 as seqNum, 20 as action_flags, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 24 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 25 as vsys_name, 26 as DeviceName, 27 as vsys_id, 28 as factortype, 29 as factorcompletiontime, 30 as factorno, 31 as f3, 32 as f4, 33 as ugflags, 34 as userbysource
| where type = "USERID"
| timeslice 1h
| count by _timeslice, subtype
| transpose row _timeslice column subtype

panels.name: Unique Active Users Trend
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",USERID,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as virtual_system, 9 as src_ip, 10 as src_user, 11 as Data_Source_Name, 12 as Event_ID, 13 as RepeatCount, 14 as TimeOutThreshold, 15 as src_port, 16 as dest_port, 17 as DataSource, 18 as DataSourceType, 19 as seqNum, 20 as action_flags, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 24 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 25 as vsys_name, 26 as DeviceName, 27 as vsys_id, 28 as factortype, 29 as factorcompletiontime, 30 as factorno, 31 as f3, 32 as f4, 33 as ugflags, 34 as userbysource
| where type = "USERID"
| timeslice 1h

_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",USERID,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as virtual_system, 9 as src_ip, 10 as src_user, 11 as Data_Source_Name, 12 as Event_ID, 13 as RepeatCount, 14 as TimeOutThreshold, 15 as src_port, 16 as dest_port, 17 as DataSource, 18 as DataSourceType, 19 as seqNum, 20 as action_flags, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 24 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 25 as vsys_name, 26 as DeviceName, 27 as vsys_id, 28 as factortype, 29 as factorcompletiontime, 30 as factorno, 31 as f3, 32 as f4, 33 as ugflags, 34 as userbysource

panels.name: Top 10 Users Connecting From Multiple IPs
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/PaloAltoNetworksv9 ",USERID,"
| csv _raw extract 1 as f1, 2 as Receive_Time, 3 as serialNum, 4 as type, 5 as subtype, 6 as f2, 7 as LogGenerationTime, 8 as virtual_system, 9 as src_ip, 10 as src_user, 11 as Data_Source_Name, 12 as Event_ID, 13 as RepeatCount, 14 as TimeOutThreshold, 15 as src_port, 16 as dest_port, 17 as DataSource, 18 as DataSourceType, 19 as seqNum, 20 as action_flags, 21 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L1, 22 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L2, 23 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L3, 24 as Device_Group_Hierarchy_L4, 25 as vsys_name, 26 as DeviceName, 27 as vsys_id, 28 as factortype, 29 as factorcompletiontime, 30 as factorno, 31 as f3, 32 as f4, 33 as ugflags, 34 as userbysource
| where type = "USERID"
| count_distinct(src_ip) as distinct_src_ips by src_user 
| where distinct_src_ips > 1 
| top 10 src_user by distinct_src_ips, src_user asc
